findings.message: be/.starcistacks/cache/fingerprint.jsonl is a dataset or model artifact; keep only small build-time binaries in be/src/assets/<kind>/, put user media in object storage, and keep model weights and datasets outside git

be/.starcistacks/cache/fingerprint.jsonl is tracked but repo.side-root-forbidden is forbidden in the tree; it belongs at the app root: one package.json, lockfile, hfs.json, README, git and CI files, hooks, formatter, Sonar and Codecov configuration, scripts/, .starciwork, be/.starcistacks and .sops.yaml per app
